description:
Most people think their comfort zone is about habits, but it goes deeper than that.
Tony Robbins explains how your identity acts like an internal thermostat. You may want more in your health, relationships, finances, or career—but if your identity hasn’t changed, you’ll keep getting pulled back toward what feels familiar.
Lasting change happens when you expand who you believe you are.

fulltitle: Your Comfort Zone Is Your Identity
